title: Quarterly cPanel Updates | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Quarterly cPanel Updates Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000085369 cPanel Updates cPanel updates include a variety of security, bug and feature updates to the server software and the cPanel interface. These updates generally include new features, bug fixes, kernel updates, critical security updates and new versions of included software packages that manages the server itself. These updates will run every 3 months on the 18th of the month. The script is set to run on Eastern Standard Time. The schedule is as follows: 2025-03-18 00:00:00 2025-06-18 00:00:00 2025-09-18 00:00:00 2025-12-18 00:00:00 2026-03-18 00:00:00 2026-06-18 00:00:00 2026-09-18 00:00:00 2026-12-18 00:00:00 The admin will display a banner when this is taking place: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
